brief.scope: Owner-requested read-only Loopstrap comparison. Earlier worker could not fetch source; SOURCE.json now identifies a local no-checkout Git clone pinned to xormania/loopstrap@ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a. Use git show/ls-tree against that object store, no network or execution of repository code needed. Inspect concrete harness configurability/extensibility, role/capability policy, onboarding/discovery, lifecycle, enforcement and diagnostics. Compare with supplied current Agentscient plan/contract and owner requirements. Return <=1200 words with immutable GitHub source links and exact paths/lines: useful implemented mechanisms versus aspirations, fit to existing Agentscient owners, and bounded recommendations grouped into steps 1-4. No automatic adoption, copied code, new authority/store or second harness system; no edits/settings/tests/host changes. Preserve repo@sha provenance and declare inspection limits. This is research, not approval of the current plan. Prefer source facts over branding.

findings.claim: The documented step 3 omits explicit owner-required selection constraints and capability separation. Expected: “Role restrictions such as Daybreak/security must be enforceable selection constraints”; found: “Profile configuration, separate Claude/Codex/Grok adapters” and generic shared policy. This leaves model restrictions, declared-versus-measured capabilities, and explicit dispatch choices outside the documented deliverable. Carry these requirements into step 3 without implementing them in step 1.

artifacts.comparison: Source: xormania/loopstrap@ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a. Loopstrap offers implemented configuration, routing, certification and recovery mechanisms worth studying. It does not supply an operational replacement for conduct: [launch-loop.sh:1-8](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/launch-loop.sh#L1-L8) unconditionally refuses, while [loopstrap_core/cli.py:43-67](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/cli.py#L43-L67) fixes certified=false. These are concrete implementation limits, not inferred from branding. Research only; no plan approval or adoption.
artifacts.step_1: Discovery contract: learn from the compact, vendor-neutral orientation and explicit authority/method/record distinction in [.agents/README.md:3-43](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/.agents/README.md#L3-L43). This is authored documentation, not automatic onboarding or measured discovery. Agentscient already declares the appropriate home: [ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md:20-46](https://github.com/uscient/agentscient/blob/8601d2534d37ec284187d827c69c82ee6b99bd39/ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md#L20-L46), extending lane_read/lane_mcp. Recommendation: retain compact ownership/action cards and explicit evidence standing; document the later capability/constraint projection and resolve the finding above. Do not promote either project's descriptive map into another authority.
artifacts.step_2: Shared read service: Loopstrap's [loopstrap_core/context.py:13-32](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/context.py#L13-L32) implements a role-specific artifact-key exclusion for test authors. Useful principle: constrain supplied context at assembly. Its check examines labels; it does not establish content isolation or fresh-session discovery. Agentscient's existing [lane_read.py:1195-1213](https://github.com/uscient/agentscient/blob/8601d2534d37ec284187d827c69c82ee6b99bd39/ops/conductor/tools/lane_read.py#L1195-L1213) already composes bounded brief data with declared omissions. Recommendation: extend that service through independent tests, implementation and review, preserving CLI/MCP parity, allowlisted ref reads, provenance and explicit ambiguity. Prove both profiles can recover relevant records without supplied paths; do not import Loopstrap's context or artifact store.
artifacts.step_3:
Harness configuration, enforcement and diagnostics: [profiles.py:165-219](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/profiles.py#L165-L219) loads validated profiles and renders token vectors/environment templates; [wrappers.py:120-188](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/wrappers.py#L120-L188) rejects undeclared overrides and compiles launch plans. This is useful configurability, but not proof of transparent interactive argv forwarding, hooks or resume. Certification discovery still contains vendor-specific defaults in [certification.py:449-495](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/certification.py#L449-L495).

[RoleRouter, harness.py:459-507](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/harness.py#L459-L507) rejects disabled/uncertified treatments, missing capabilities and configured independence violations. These are routing checks, not per-tool conductor enforcement. The tracked [.claude/settings.json:2-78](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/.claude/settings.json#L2-L78) explicitly describes lane discipline as doctrinal and sets bypassPermissions; that approach does not satisfy the owner's enforced delegation boundary.

[certification.py:397-425](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/certification.py#L397-L425) checks receipt identity, required passing layers, executable bytes and evidence availability. Its [mechanical evaluator:843-883](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/certification.py#L843-L883) requires complete ordered observations. Recommendation: express equivalent evidence obligations through existing harness/dispatch contracts and docs/probes.md, with shared conductor policy owned outside vendor adapters. Preserve explicit model selection, enforce Daybreak/security restrictions, and record requested versus observed capabilities. Test positive/negative tool attempts, effects, malformed hooks, override conflicts, resume and actual MCP connection; unreachable cases cannot pass. Extend existing machinery and the declared Symfony AI boundary, without another harness system, fixed job/model table or certification authority.
artifacts.step_4: Lifecycle: [recovery.py:39-81](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/recovery.py#L39-L81) implements idempotent dispatch reservation; [89-123](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/loopstrap_core/recovery.py#L89-L123) rejects stale responses against reservation/current revisions. These are useful recovery invariants. [.claude/commands/retro.md:1-5](https://github.com/xormania/loopstrap/blob/ca5ab8d363f8822ac5406f5e0bf5c94288102f1a/.claude/commands/retro.md#L1-L5) is a prompt for a draft retrospective, not canonical lifecycle publication. Recommendation: specify idempotency and revision checks within Agentscient's existing workflow genus and record lineage. Keep handoff, AAR and combined closeout explicitly owner-initiated; checkpoints remain unfinished recovery evidence. Do not adopt Loopstrap's ledger or infer completed closeout from exit.
